body:
I have a few remarks on this one.

> The url sync needs to override the defaults parameter set by any other components. So it should always come last in the initialisation.

Do you suggest we automatically push it last in the list, or that we educate users into adding the widget last in their code?

> The update should take place each time there is an update of the SearchParameters

I would have done it everytime we call `search` on the helper instead. This is a tiny difference but this makes more sense as the url should reflect the state of the current display of the page (which is not triggered until we `search()`)

Also, even if we use the default queryString, we should pack all our data in one variable, as to not collide with variables already defined in our customer implementation. 

I think the state->string and string->state logic should be in the helper, but the url synchronisation and load should be in the widget.
